fact: The National Registration Bureau produces identity cards at its Nairobi headquarters, taking three weeks to a month before cards return to the county (county registration officer).

KBC reports Immigration and Citizen Services PS Julius Bitok saying the government declined foreign firms' offers to build Maisha Namba and prefers to upgrade the existing foundational ID with local experts and homegrown IT solutions.

Immigration PS Julius Bitok said the National Registration Bureau prints national ID cards at its own printing centre in Nairobi, running 24-hour shifts, and has procured a new printer to raise capacity.

The Elephant says AFIS is managed by the National Registration Bureau, which issues identification documents, and that officials upgraded the existing IPRS-AFIS infrastructure into the Maisha system rather than build a new one.
